description: Paid (x402 v2, USDC on Base, only to the Kokomoji jobs Safe 0xb2492145ea92947C0b8dF138a398fcB22782a575; charged only when the result is delivered). Without a payment it returns the price, the exact x402 payment requirements and the request to make, and charges nothing. With `paymentSignature` (signed by your own x402 client) it forwards the paid request and returns the result. Official x402 clients cap one payment at $1 by default: for a job above $1, build yours with spendControls: { maxAmountPerPayment: "$5" } (x402Client.fromConfig) or the answer's clientCap setting, or it refuses to sign. The local server pays by itself from your wallet within your caps. Keep the jobKey: job_result fetches a delivered result again with it.

input.description: The job's input object, exactly as its docs and jobs_list's example show.

job.description: A job id from jobs_list, like send-check.

jobKey.description: X-Job-Key, 22 to 128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -. Reuse the one returned with the payment requirements.

maxUsd.description: Local server: refuse to pay more than this for this call (your configured per-call cap always applies).

paymentSignature.description: Optional: a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value (base64) that your own x402 v2 client signed for the paymentRequired this tool returned. It is forwarded as is; this server never signs.

name: job_run
title: Run a paid job
